sampling_note: Seed initialized once; each repeat collects train then eval, with continuous policy RNG across repeats. Pretrained repeat 0 has the same policy-RNG prefix as each one-repeat checkpoint job. DDPM deterministic=True still adds noise at t>0, and zero noise at t=0. Seed 5000 aligns policy RNG streams across checkpoints, but the existing wrapper does not seed Gym's underlying np_random generator, so initial environment states are not fully paired; environment seeding remains unchanged.
uncertainty: Episode standard error uses sample SD (ddof=1)/sqrt(n); 160 episodes per selected sampler.
action_units: action_oor_frac uses physical actions sent to Gym after the wrapper's float32 affine unnormalization; policy_action_oor_frac separately uses normalized policy coordinates.
segment_units: Mean raw decision reward within each 50-decision bin; standard error is over episode bin means.
